title: DuckMoo Nexus | Azeroth Stock Exchange
description: Search by item name. Blizzard listings, cached observations and confirmed personal transactions stay distinct.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.imports UNION SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.source_snapshots

list.name: item
list.label: Matching item
list.query:
SELECT name||' ['||item_id::text||']' AS __text,item_id::text AS __value
        FROM nexus.item_catalog WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring}
        AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(aliases) n WHERE strpos(lower(n),lower(${item_search:sqlstring}))>0)
          OR item_id::text=${item_search:sqlstring}) ORDER BY name,item_id LIMIT 500

list.name: market_scope
list.label: Addon market
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT scope FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Current Blizzard asking prices
panels.description: Latest preserved snapshot per market. Asking prices are not completed sales. Variant details remain separate. Source update and fetch time are shown separately.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.scope,p.item_id,c.name,p.quantity,p.listings,
        p.lowest_unit_copper/10000.0 AS lowest_unit_gold,p.item_variant,
        p.source_modified_at,p.fetched_at FROM nexus.latest_auction_prices p
        LEFT JOIN nexus.item_catalog c ON c.namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND c.item_id=p.item_id
        WHERE p.region='us' AND p.item_id=substring(${item:sqlstring} FROM '^[0-9]{1,18}$')::bigint ORDER BY p.scope,p.lowest_unit_copper

panels.title: Blizzard asking price over time
panels.description: Lowest asking price across variants in each market; consult the current listing table for exact variants.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(s.source_modified_at,s.fetched_at) AS time,s.scope AS metric,
        min(coalesce(a.unit_price_copper,a.buyout_copper::numeric/nullif(a.quantity,0)))/10000.0 AS value
        FROM nexus.api_snapshots s JOIN nexus.auction_listings a ON a.snapshot_id=s.id
        WHERE s.region='us' AND a.item_id=substring(${item:sqlstring} FROM '^[0-9]{1,18}$')::bigint AND $__timeFilter(s.fetched_at)
        GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Blizzard observed listing supply
panels.description: Listing disappearance can reflect cancellation, expiry or relisting; it is not sales volume.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(s.source_modified_at,s.fetched_at) AS time,s.scope AS metric,sum(a.quantity) AS value
        FROM nexus.api_snapshots s JOIN nexus.auction_listings a ON a.snapshot_id=s.id
        WHERE s.region='us' AND a.item_id=substring(${item:sqlstring} FROM '^[0-9]{1,18}$')::bigint AND $__timeFilter(s.fetched_at)
        GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Auctionator daily price range for selected item

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time,scope||' low' AS metric,(metrics->>'lowest_low')::numeric/10000.0 AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND scope IN (${market_scope:sqlstring}) AND time_precision='day_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT observed_at AS time,scope AS metric,(metrics->>'highest_quantity')::numeric AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND scope IN (${market_scope:sqlstring}) AND time_precision='day_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT observed_at AS time,scope AS metric,(metrics->>'min_buyout')::numeric/10000.0 AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND scope IN (${market_scope:sqlstring}) AND metrics ? 'min_buyout' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Selected item: observations across markets
panels.description: Daily extrema, cached quotes and regional estimates retain their source meaning.

targets.rawSql: SELECT scope,source,observed_at,time_precision,metrics,quality FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND scope IN (${market_scope:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

panels.title: Confirmed personal transactions for selected item

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at,character,realm,category,subtype,item_name,quantity,invoice_value_copper/10000.0 AS invoice_g FROM nexus.transactions WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_id::text=${item:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT region,scope,status,last_attempt,last_success,next_attempt FROM nexus.api_worker_status ORDER BY region,scope

panels.title: Source refresh and API poll health

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.region,p.scope,p.fetched_at,p.status,s.source_modified_at,s.auction_count FROM nexus.api_polls p LEFT JOIN nexus.api_snapshots s ON s.id=p.snapshot_id ORDER BY p.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Item-name coverage
panels.description: Names come from preserved item hyperlinks and transactions. Items with no known name will be enriched separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS named_item_ids FROM nexus.item_catalog WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring}

panels.title: Crafting observation coverage
panels.description: Operation previews and outcomes are not completed crafts or realized profits.

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind,count(*) AS observations,max(observed_at) AS newest FROM nexus.crafting_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} GROUP BY kind
